title: Round down, then fill

blocks.text: A district picks transformer replacements under one budget: maximize $`\sum_j v_j x_j`$ subject to $`\sum_j c_j x_j \le B`$, $`x_j \in \{0, 1\}`$, with every $`c_j > 0`$. A node LP of the search returned a point $`x^*`$, and the district wants a plan from it now.
Write `round_and_fill(values, costs, budget, x)` in `fill.py`. Return the sorted list of the items in the plan built in two steps:

items: **Round down.** Keep item $`j`$ when $`x^*_j \ge 1 - 10^{-6}`$; drop every other item.

**Fill.** Go through the items not kept, in order of $`v_j / c_j`$ from highest to lowest (ties by item name), and add each one whose cost fits in what is left of the budget. An item that does not fit is skipped, and the next one is tried.

blocks.text: The point $`x^*`$ satisfies the budget row, so the rounded-down plan does too.

cases.says: items at 1 stay, the fractional item goes, and nothing else fits
an item the LP point left partly unfunded is added back when the budget allows it
an LP value of 0.9999999 is 1 up to the solver's tolerance, so the item stays
an item at 0.6 is rounded down even though it is nearer to 1
after an item too large for what is left, smaller items further down the list are still tried
